body:
Filing gate: maintainer-directed task. Filed by the 18.2.0 release-assessment thread · `session_01G3h9iZTpL8aCiXbfsp8H5u`. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not dispatched.

**Maintainer's words** (project thread, 2026-10-25, verbatim): 22:54Z 「约 300 条清单准确性问题：是不是应该开卡？」, then 22:55Z 「写issue，不派发」.

**Parent:** wave anchor #25807 (18.2.0 release test sweep). RUNNER's extraction obligation parks checklist-accuracy findings on the anchor; the maintainer asked for them as issues, so the wave's findings are split into one card per ledger file and the anchor links each card. This is not a release blocker, so it carries no `target:v18`.

**Reader who acts:** the lane owning `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**` (`domain:devx`). Dedupe (open and closed): no card holds these lines; the 18.0 precedent closed its accuracy rows on its anchor #24579.

## Wanted

For each line below, edit `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/attachments-storage.json`: revise the item's text, bump its `revision`, and append a `history` entry citing the run record the line comes from. Keep `pnpm check:platform-checklist` green. A line that turns out to describe a product defect rather than stale text gets its own card instead of a ledger edit.

## Findings (18)

### From #25815 — `release-18.2.0-tier1`, 156 items, at `6679644a`, pin `b41ed7f68956` (clause labels: aK = acceptance[K], nK = negative[K])

- `attachments-storage.attach-requires-parent-edit` a2: the uploader legs of '(a) granted member: uploader may delete…' are an admin (who edits everything) and memberA on att_case (public_read_write, so memberA edits it); 'the uploader succeeds even without parent edit' is not driven
- `attachments-storage.attach-requires-parent-edit` n1: none of the refused-attach cases ((b), (item 3), (#2727)) re-reads sys_attachment for a row the refusal left
- `attachments-storage.chunked-upload-integrity` a1: the clause names details.missingChunks [1] (chunk 1 not sent); the dogfood pin withholds chunk 0 and asserts [0] — same behaviour, the clause's literal does not match the pin's fixture.
- `attachments-storage.download-authz-both-sides` a2: ref claims 'the uploader/entitled 200' covers clause 2; the owner case is the admin, who also owns/reads the parent, so the uploader-bypass-against-unreadable-parent leg and the 'url serves the bytes' leg are unasserted
- `attachments-storage.inline-grid-receipt-cells` a2: the spec does not capture the /api/v1/storage/* upload requests; storage routing is inferred from the file door returning the uploaded bytes
- `attachments-storage.inline-grid-receipt-cells` a3: the spec never reads the sys_file row (status 'committed', ref_object/ref_id/ref_field, acl 'private') nor asserts the batch response succeeded — only the request payload and GET /storage/files/:id
- `attachments-storage.inline-grid-receipt-cells` n1: a data: URL would satisfy typeof==='string' && !contains('receipt.png'); the n1 guard rests on the follow-up storage GET answering 200 with the PNG bytes
- `attachments-storage.orphan-tombstone-reap` a1: the dogfood sweep is lifecycle.sweep() called in-process after HTTP-driven setup (no door exists for it); the failed-byte-delete-leaves-the-row leg and its warn log are pinned only in attachment-lifecycle.test.ts with a fake engine.
- `attachments-storage.presigned-upload-roundtrip` ref is bare: attachments-permission-matrix is a permission-matrix file whose uploadFile helper drives presign/PUT/complete but asserts only statuses; a0–a3's field, pending→committed, byte-equality and 302 halves are unpinned
- `attachments-storage.presigned-upload-roundtrip` a4: the anonymous case asserts 401 + AUTH_REQUIRED but never counts sys_file rows around the attempt
- `attachments-storage.read-inherits-parent-rls` a3: the probe half (D5 classes, warning text, probe-failure deny) is in-process/unit only; the item states it is unreachable from a run, so scoring it from those pins follows the item's own verify — note the warning's exact '[storage] attachment read visibility' text is asserted only at unit
- `attachments-storage.sys-file-status-pipeline` a2: the live-holder half is scored, as the item directs, from tombstone-download-live-reference.test.ts, a unit test (mock HTTP server + fake engine); the live holder-less 404 FILE_NOT_FOUND and the post-re-attach /url 200 legs have no pin.
- `attachments-storage.sys-file-status-pipeline` a1: tombstone-download-live-reference.test.ts 'leaves `pending` refused — only the tombstone limb widened' is a unit route test; the api-oracle 404 FILE_NOT_FOUND has no HTTP pin.
- `attachments-storage.upload-limits-scope-and-ownership` a1–a3: storage-limits, upload-scope-vocabulary and upload-door-ownership call registered RouteHandlers with hand-built IHttpRequest/IHttpResponse — no HTTP adapter; a1's 'takes effect without restart' is at the plugin/kernel, not a served request
- `attachments-storage.upload-limits-scope-and-ownership` a5: both hydrate pins are engine-level; no pin reads a copied file id over /data
- `attachments-storage.upload-session-abort` a2/a3/n0/n1: packages/services/service-storage/src/attachment-lifecycle.test.ts › createUploadSessionReapGuard ('does NOT abort a completed session', 'reaps a session with no backend_upload_id without calling abort', 'VETOES on abort failure...', 'reaps the row when the adapter cannot abort at all') asserts these at unit layer but is not in the ref
- `attachments-storage.upload-session-abort` a5: packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-routes.test.ts ('stamps expired and 410s a chunk PUT / a completion past the session deadline', 'does not expire a session still inside its deadline') asserts the 410 at route-handler unit layer, not in the ref (would not score the api oracle)
- `attachments-storage.upload-session-abort` bare ref names only the dogfood matrix file; it scores a1 alone

## Acceptance

- Every line above is either applied (item revised, `revision` bumped, `history` cites the record) or answered on this card with the reason it was not.
- `pnpm check:platform-checklist` is green.
- The PR links this card and #25807.
